[[Jaw Smokeskin]] is the [[Charr]] [[boss]] who performed the ritual that caused the [[Searing]]. He can be found in both [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-]] and [[Ascalon|post-Searing Ascalon]].

== Locations ==
* [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
** {{NPC location|The Northlands}}

* [[Ascalon]]
** {{NPC location|Nolani Academy}}

9 [[Fire Magic]]
* {{Skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{Skill icon|Conjure Flame}}
* {{Skill icon|Flare}}
* {{Skill icon|Lava Font}}

* [[Charr Bag]] ([[unique]]) (pre-Searing only)
* [[Charr Carving]]
* [[Charr Hide]]
* [[Charr Salvage Kit]] (pre-Searing only)
* [[Flame Wielder Trappings]]

== Notes ==
* In pre-Searing, three things set this boss apart from the others:
** Unlike the other Charr bosses, his spawning location does not change.
** He is not standing on the altar like the three other bosses, but at the bottom of the stairs leading to it. He is usually the first encountered by the player.
** There are no other Charr of the same profession (elementalist) in the Northlands, which also means he is the only foe that can [[drop]] [[Item rarity|purple]] elementalist weapons. 
*** If he uses [[Conjure Flame]], he has a chance to wield and drop a [[Fire Wand]] or a [[Fire Staff]].
